canon_ref.note: Climbing a trail-less mountain by faerie guidance, Ryoka finds Mrsha alive at the bottom of a hidden crevasse beside the armored Goblin that chased her there and died in the same fall; she free-climbs both of them out with Urksh's enchanted rope, losing two fingers to a Goblin bite along the way.

b2.ryoka_pulls_mrsha_from_the_crevasse.summary: Climbing a trail-less mountain by faerie guidance, Ryoka finds Mrsha alive at the bottom of a hidden crevasse and free-climbs both of them out with an enchanted rope, fighting off two Goblin ambushes and losing two fingers to a bite.

b2.goblin_lords_army_destroys_stone_spea.news: Terrible word from the north: a Goblin Lord's army, a Necromancer commanding thousands, has all but destroyed a Gnoll tribe, and even General Zel Shivertail's Drakes had to fall back from it.

canon_ref.note: A vast army (thousands of Goblins, 100+ armored Hobs, a Necromancer Goblin Lord who raises the tribe's own dead) overruns the camp. Zel and Ilvriss cut in but choose to save the fleeing Gnolls over the kill; Urksh dies covering Ryoka and Mrsha's escape.

b2.goblin_lords_army_destroys_stone_spea.summary: A Goblin Lord's army - thousands of Goblins and armored Hobs, led by a Necromancer who raises the tribe's own dead - overruns the Stone Spears camp. Zel and Ilvriss choose to save the fleeing Gnolls rather than press the attack, and Urksh dies covering Ryoka and Mrsha's escape.

canon_ref.note: The faeries carry Ryoka and Mrsha through the paralyzed battlefield, paying the price they warned of with Urksh's death. The System offers Ryoka [Barefoot Runner], but a faerie cancels it: she never gains a level (user, 2026-09-26). Event id kept for old saves.

b2.ryoka_escapes_with_mrsha_gains_first_.summary: The Frost Faeries carry Ryoka and Mrsha through the frozen battlefield at impossible speed to save them, at the cost they warned of. That night a class reaches for Ryoka and a faerie snuffs it out; she stays without a level. Mrsha's fur turns pure white for no reason anyone can explain.

system.name: [Barefoot Runner] offered, cancelled
system.note: The System offers [Barefoot Runner] with three Skills, but a faerie cancels it. Ryoka never gains a level (user, 2026-09-26).
